chase: Come on, I can hear your shoes from here.
Running again? Fine. It only makes you easier to find.
Left at the vending machine. I know you took that turn.
Your footsteps bounce off every wall. Very helpful of you.
I am coming through, so step out of my way.
Stop sprinting in straight lines. It is embarrassing to watch.
Three doors back, two turns. Honestly, you are not subtle.
Keep moving. I like a chase that actually goes somewhere.
Closing in on the stairs. Don't make me say it twice.
Every hall you cross leaves a trail for me to follow.
Mind the corner, I'll be standing right behind it.
I move faster when I'm annoyed, and you have annoyed me.
You're heading for the lounge. How convenient for me.
Still running? Good. I was getting bored of waiting.
I can track you by the flashlight bouncing down the hall.
Honestly, the running again. Slow down, please.
Your shoes are squeaking. I can follow that all night.
Keep going. It only gets you found sooner.
catch: Nice try. You almost made it to the stairs.
Got you. This house needs its quiet back, so out you go.
Found you. Sorry, that is simply how the house works.
Pulled you out. Try not to take it personally.
Dragging you out now. Don't be dramatic about it.
Too slow. Now you're on the way out, with me holding your arm.
That's a catch. Shake it off on the way out.
One more out. The rest of you, keep your eyes open.
Another one out. The house is quiet again, for now.
Taken, and not even out of breath. Rude.
That's one out. The rest of you stay put.
Ejected, and no hard feelings, mostly.
Back to the front door. You know the way out.
Out you go. I'll walk you there myself.
Caught. Next time, pick a door that actually locks.
Right, that's the end of that. Come along.
Caught again. Honestly, you're easy to find.
Stop struggling. You'll only make me cross.
hear: Was that a door? Somebody is being loud again.
I heard that. Something just broke in the kitchen.
Footsteps upstairs. Who else is walking around?
Shouting in the lounge. I'm going to look.
Something fell over. I'm going to check it now.
That door just slammed. Who did that?
A noise like that doesn't get ignored. I'm coming.
Glass breaking? Of course it is. On my way.
Whoever that was, I heard you. Stay where you are.
Quiet in here, then a bang. Not my favorite combination.
Something shifted in the vent. Keep the noise down.
That floor creaked over there. Right, I'm going.
That sounded like a drawer. Somebody left it open.
Heard a bang two halls away. Moving to look.
Someone is humming in the stairwell. Knock that off.
Crash in the kitchen. That's the third this week.
Somebody left the back door open again. Ugh.
A chair scraped, and I know who did that.
search: Where did you go? Don't tell me you ran off.
I lost you. That's the last time I say that.
Checking the rooms again. Every single one of them.
Nobody here. Fine, back to my route.
Sniffing around the lounge. Nothing yet.
Lost your trail at the stairwell. Annoying.
Back to patrol, then. I'm still watching the corners.
No footsteps. You're either smart or very quiet.
Okay, you're gone. I'll come back when you're careless.
Checking the cabinet again. Twice in one night?
Gone quiet. I hate it when that happens.
I'll walk this hall one more time. Slowly.
Going back to patrol. Don't expect a second warning.
Where did the trail go? Somebody find me a trail.
Nothing in the copy room. Nothing in the hall either.
stunned: Ow. Give me one second, that stung.
My gill plates are rattling. Give me a moment.
That was a cheap shot. I'm shaking it off.
Stop hitting me, I'm trying to think.
Fine, you got me. Enjoy it while it lasts.
My servo hinge is jammed. This is so annoying.
Hold on. Give my head a second to reboot.
Okay, I'm up. Don't do that again.
Stunned is not my favorite look. Or any look.
My lens is flickering. Just wait, I'm fine.
Shaking it off. Five more seconds, that's all.
Rude. I was just about to come after you.
I'll be fine. Mostly my pride is hurt.
Standing back up now. Nothing broke, unfortunately for you.
Ugh. I'll have a bruise, and you'll have a problem.
hide_spot: Hiding in a locker again? Very original of you.
Oh, you're in the cabinet. I can see your shoes.
That locker is not hiding you. Not from me.
You're shaking in there. I can hear every rattle.
Out you come. Checking hiding spots is my job.
Pressed against the wall like that is a plan, I guess.
Behind the curtain? Everyone checks there first, you know.
I can hear you breathing inside that bed frame.
Under the bed, really? Fine, I'll get down there.
I'm opening this one slowly. Brace yourself.
The locker door is ajar. You're not sneaky at all.
Stop counting my hiding spots out loud. I can hear you.
That closet is my next stop. Get comfortable, or don't.
Nice hiding spot. Terrible choice of shoes.
Every hiding spot in this room is on my list.
light: Your flashlight just swept across my face. Rude.
You have a lovely flashlight, but it doesn't help you here.
Pointing that flashlight at me? Wonderful. Really.
Turn that lamp down, it's stinging my lens.
Ugh, too bright. My violet lenses hate this.
Lamp in my eyes again. Are you trying to blind me?
Okay, I can't see a thing. Keep the beam off me.
Dazzled. That is a cheap trick, and it's working.
Keep that beam away from my face, please.
Stop with the light. I'm trying to find you.
That glare is so annoying. Point it somewhere else.
A beam straight into my lens? Ridiculous.
Flashlight in my face, and now I'm blinking like a fool.
Give me a second. The light is making a mess of everything.
Light again. Do you ever turn that thing off?
idle: Cold bath at midnight, because being warm is a personal insult.
Crossword finished. I did it out of spite, obviously.
Nine letters for a word meaning annoying. Got it fast.
Someone left the heater on in the lounge again. Ugh.
I fill in crosswords in pen, so there's no going back.
Cold water and a good puzzle. That is my whole evening.
Don't hand me a warm blanket. I'll return it with an attitude.
My gill plates like the cold. Let everyone else sweat.
Hot cocoa? I'd rather sit in an icy tub, thanks.
The lounge is far too warm. Everyone pretend I'm not sweating.
Oh, a puzzle book. Finally, something worth my time.
The others are far too cheerful for this hour, honestly.
If you're going to wander, at least bring a flashlight.
Keep your voice down. Some of us are trying to be annoyed in peace.
Leave my crossword alone. I'm not finished with it.
ability: Watch this spot. It's about to get hot.
Stand back from that locker, it's going to burn.
Bracing against the locker now. That means a charge is coming.
The heat is climbing. Hiding spots do not like it either.
An occupied spot pops open when it burns. Consider yourself warned.
Get out of that spot. Now, before I start bracing.
Once I burn a spot, it stays dark for a while.
Every spot in this room is a suspect now. Including yours.
I'm charging the locker, not you. Yet.
That hiding spot is burned out now. It needs time to recover.
I just burned one of these lockers. Try the next one.
The hall gets hotter every time I break something.
Door's in my way. Stand clear, I'm going through.
Lowering my head. This door is coming down.
That door was stubborn. My head is ringing now.
mechanic: Back stairs are safe, for now. Don't bet on it.
Left door first, then the stairs. You're welcome.
Fine, here's a tip. Use the back stairs and stay low.
Need a hiding place? Try the one I'm not burning.
Batteries don't last forever. Neither does your luck.
Vents are loud. I can hear you crawling through them.
Radar pings give you away if you stand still.
Don't pick up that item. It's not yours to keep.
Falling down that gap only makes it easier for me.
Stairs make noise. Take them slowly if you want to hide.
Sabotage the relay and you'll only make me angry.
Relay cables run behind this wall. Don't touch them.
Pulling a breaker won't stop me from finding you.
Those doors lock on a timer. I know exactly when.
Heat builds with every burn. Keep an eye on the gauge.
The relay's buried in the coat closet. Typical.
Stairs are the only quiet way up. Don't break them.
Batteries run out when you run around. Save them.
